research_status: Partial Q3 update; cash flow and deferred compensation reconciliation pending
decision_es: Q3 incorporado; pendiente CFO/capex y conciliación del plan diferido. Sin valoración actual certificada ni entrada.
decision_en: Q3 incorporated; CFO/capex and deferred-plan reconciliation remain pending. No certified current valuation or entry.
publication_note: Keep A04229.43/47.51/74.20 as historical sensitivity only, never current valuation. This update does not complete3FY4QTTM or FCFF. Replace stale awaiting-Q3 with precise cash-flow/plan-data pending status.
pros_es: Ventas Q3 antes de reembolsos +11,66% y beneficio neto +10,34%; la mejora no depende solo de ingresos de paso.
Caja sube frente a julio y cuentas por cobrar bajan, señales favorables pendientes de confirmar con flujos.
La guía anual mejora y EBITDA conserva el coste de SBC; no se utiliza EBITDAS para aprobar.
cons_es: No hay CFO/capex Q3 verificados en el comunicado; el TTM de caja de julio no es un TTM actual.
EBIT GAAP +44,21% necesita conciliar el plan diferido y otros ingresos; no se trata como crecimiento operativo limpio.
La sensibilidad histórica 47,51 no se renueva ni respalda automáticamente el cierre de 85,97; falta FCFF completo y contraste de pares.
pros_en: Q3 revenue before reimbursements grew 11.66% and net income 10.34%; improvement is not solely pass-through revenue.
Cash increased versus July and receivables declined, favorable signals awaiting cash-flow confirmation.
Annual guidance improved and EBITDA retains SBC; EBITDAS is not used to approve entry.
cons_en: Q3 CFO/capex are not verified in the release; July trailing cash flow is not a current TTM figure.
GAAP EBIT growth of 44.21% needs deferred-compensation and other-income reconciliation; it is not treated as clean operating growth.
Historical sensitivity of $47.51 is not renewed and does not automatically support the $85.97 close; full FCFF and peer checks remain.
